kernel.policy: All channels build one kernel: the head of ref in url at build start, at default_version unless --kernel selects another. The Linux version needs a reviewed Uke profile in that source, the release is read from its spec, and latest means the newest kernel.org stable release; channel names select RPM repositories only.

hardware.policy: Stable image builds compile the six required public platform families locally; testing and unstable use signed test-repository packages.
